en.title: Kyiv and Moscow report massive overnight drone exchange
en.dek: Moscow mayor says 600 drones targeted capital as Russia reports 1,336 intercepted
facts: Moscow Mayor Sergey Sobyanin claimed around 600 drones targeting the capital were shot down overnight,Russia's Ministry of Defense stated 1,336 Ukrainian drones were intercepted in one of Kyiv's largest aerial attacks

Kyiv Post reported strikes on an oil depot and gas distribution station in Azov, industrial sites in Krasnodar Krai and Yaroslavl Oblast, and the Crimean bridge,Astra reported Ukraine's General Staff struck the Akhtubinsk military airfield in Astrakhan Oblast and a facility near Cimbulovo in Oryol Oblast
Kyiv Post listed two fatalities and several injuries caused by falling debris or attacks on cars in Bryansk, Belgorod and Donetsk Peoples' Republic
body: Moscow Mayor Sergey Sobyanin claimed that around 600 unmanned aerial vehicles targeting the Russian capital were shot down overnight. Russia's Ministry of Defense said 1,336 Ukrainian drones had been intercepted in what it described as one of Kyiv's largest aerial attacks of the war.,Kyiv Post reported strikes on an oil depot and a gas distribution station in the Russian city of Azov, as well as industrial sites in Krasnodar Krai and the Yaroslavl Oblast, and the Crimean bridge. Separately, Astra reported claims by Ukraine's General Staff that it had struck the Akhtubinsk military airfield in Russia's Astrakhan Oblast, home to Russia's 929th State Flight Test Center, along with a facility near Cimbulovo in the Oryol Oblast used to store, prepare and launch drones.

Russia's state news agency TASS confirmed Sobyanin's statement and provided a detailed summary of the wider results of what they deemed had been one of Kyiv's largest drone attacks of the year. According to the report, around 1,336 UAVs were shot down over multiple regions and seas.,Kyiv Post listed two fatalities and several injuries caused by falling debris or attacks on cars in Bryansk, Belgorod and the so-called Donetsk Peoples' Republic.
en.context: On November 16, 2026, Moscow's mayor and Russia's Ministry of Defense reported large-scale drone interceptions over Russian territory. Separately, Ukraine's General Staff claimed strikes on Russian airfields and industrial sites.

fr.title: Échanges massifs de drones entre Kiev et Moscou pendant la nuit
fr.dek: Le maire de Moscou annonce 600 drones ciblant la capitale alors que la Russie rapporte 1 336 drones ukrainiens interceptés
facts: Maire de Moscou Sergey Sobianine a affirmé que quelque 600 drones visant la capitale avaient été abattus pendant la nuit ; le ministère russe de la Défense a indiqué que 1 336 drones ukrainiens avaient été interceptés dans l'une des plus grandes attaques aériennes de Kiev ; selon Kyiv Post, des strikes ont visité un dépôt de pétrole et une station de distribution de gaz à Azov, des sites industriels dans le kraï de Krasnodar et l'oblast de Iaroslavl, ainsi que le pont de Crimée ; Astra a rapporté que le État-major ukrainien avait frappé la base aérienne d'Akhtubinsk dans l'oblast d'Astrahan et une installation près de Cimbulovo dans l'oblast d'Orel ; Kyiv Post a recensé deux fatalities et plusieurs blessés causés par des débris tombants ou des attaques contre des voitures à Briansk, Belgorod et la République populaire de Donetsk. @@CONTEXT

Le 16 novembre 2026, le maire de Moscou et le ministère russe de la Défense ont rapporté de très importantes interceptions de drones sur le territoire russe. Parallèlement, le État-major ukrainien a revendiqué des strikes sur des bases aériennes et des sites industriels russes. @@CAPTION
Image illustrative d'une interception de drone au-dessus d'une zone urbaine.
body: Moscou. Le maire de la ville, Sergueï Sobianine, a affirmé que quelque 600 drones visant la capitale russe avaient été abattus pendant la nuit. Le ministère russe de la Défense a indiqué pour sa part que 1 336 drones ukrainiens avaient été interceptés, qualifiant cet événement d'une des plus grandes attaques aériennes de Kiev depuis le début de la guerre.

Des frappes ont été rapportées sur un dépôt de pétrole et une station de distribution de gaz dans la ville russe d'Azov, ainsi que sur des sites industriels du kraï de Krasnodar et de l'oblast de Iaroslavl, et le pont de Crimée. S'ajoutent les allégations d'Ukraine selon lesquelles le centre aérien d'État de 929e à Akhtoubinsk, dans l'oblast d'Astrakhan, et une installation près de Cimbulovo, dans l'oblast d'Oryol, utilisées pour stocker, préparer et lancer des drones, avaient été frappées, selon le état-major général ukrainien.

pt.title: Kyiv e Moscovo reportam grande troca de drones durante a noite
pt.dek: O prefeito de Moscovo diz que 600 drones atacaram a capital; Rússia afirma ter interceptado 1.336 drones ucranianos
facts: Moscow Mayor Sergey Sobyanin afirmou que cerca de 600 drones que atacavam a capital foram abatidos durante a noite; o Ministério da Defesa da Rússia declarou que 1.336 drones ucranianos foram interceptados em um dos maiores ataques aéreos de Kiev

Kyiv Post reportou ataques a um depósito de petróleo e a uma estação de distribuição de gás em Azov, instalações industriais no Krai de Krasnodar e na Oblast de Yaroslavl, e a ponte da Crimeia; Astra noticiou que o Estado-Maior ucraniano atingiu a base aérea de Akhtubinsk, na Oblast de Astrakhan, e uma instalação perto de Cimbulovo, na Oblast de Oryol
Kyiv Post listou duas fatalidades e vários ferimentos causados por destroços ou ataques a carros em Briansk, Belgorod e República Popular de Donetsk
body: Moscovo — O prefeito de Moscovo, Serguéi Sobianin, afirmou que cerca de 600 drones não tripulados que visavam a capital russa foram abatidos durante a noite. O Ministério da Defesa da Rússia disse que 1.336 drones ucranianos foram interceptados no que descreveu como um dos maiores ataques aéreos de Kiev desde o início da guerra.

Segundo o Kyiv Post, houve ataques a um depósito de petróleo e a uma estação de distribuição de gás na cidade russa de Azov, bem como a instalações industriais no Krai de Krasnodar e na região de Iaroslávl, e à ponte da Crimeia. Separadamente, a agência Astra reportou alegações do Estado-Maior ucraniano de que tinha atingido o aeródromo militar de Akhtubinsk, na região de Astracã, sede do Centro de Testes de Voo Estatal 929 da Rússia, juntamente com uma instalação perto de Cimbulovo, na região de Óryol, usada para armazenar, preparar e lançar drones.
pt.context: Em 16 de novembro de 2026, o prefeito de Moscovo e o Ministério da Defesa da Rússia reportaram grandes interceptações de drones sobre o território russo. Separadamente, o Estado-Maior ucraniano reivindicou ataques a bases aéreas e instalações industriais russas.

problemsFixed: Mixed numbers from Moscow mayor (600) and Russia MoD (1,336) without attribution framing; unverified casualty figures (two fatalities) from Kyiv Post listed as fact without attribution to the outlet's reporting; headline exceeds 90 characters; body contains repeated sentence openings and evaluative framing; context section contains vague generalizations not directly sourced; rhythm issues with short declarative sentences in a row
